question: In May 2025, which Indian Chief Minister announced naming a medical college after Ahilyabai Holkar in 2025?
solution: The correct answer is __**Yogi Adityanath**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Yogi Adityanath**, the Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh, announced naming a medical college after **Ahilyabai Holkar** in **May 2025**. • Ahilyabai Holkar was a renowned ruler of the Malwa kingdom, known for her contributions to the welfare of her people and the development of several temples and public works. • The announcement reflects the efforts of the Uttar Pradesh government to honor historical figures who have made significant contributions to Indian society. • The medical college named after Ahilyabai Holkar is expected to boost education and healthcare infrastructure in the state. • This initiative is part of Uttar Pradesh's focus on improving access to medical education and healthcare facilities in rural and urban areas.
